subsystems.name: Drive and chassis
subsystems.role: moves the robot and keeps it stable on carpets, tiles and thresholds.

subsystems.name: Cleaning head
subsystems.role: lifts dust and debris from the floor into the bin.

subsystems.name: Perception suite
subsystems.role: builds a map and recognises obstacles in real time.

subsystems.name: Onboard compute
subsystems.role: runs navigation, mapping and vision models without sending video to the cloud.

subsystems.name: Docking station
subsystems.role: recharges the robot and empties or washes its bin and mop between runs.

subsystems.name: Power and connectivity
subsystems.role: stores energy and links the robot to the home network and app.

buildSteps.title: Design and simulate
buildSteps.detail: Engineers model the chassis, sensors and cleaning airflow in CAD, then test navigation software in a simulated apartment before building hardware.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate chassis and drivetrain
buildSteps.detail: Plastic parts are injection-moulded, motors and gearboxes are assembled, and wheels and suspension are fitted to a rigid frame.

buildSteps.title: Build the cleaning path
buildSteps.detail: The roller brush, side brush, suction fan, air ducts and dustbin are assembled and sealed so air is drawn through the brush rather than around it.

buildSteps.title: Integrate sensors
buildSteps.detail: LiDAR, camera, inertial unit, bumpers and cliff sensors are mounted, wired and calibrated so their readings agree on the robot’s position.

buildSteps.title: Train and deploy vision models
buildSteps.detail: Large labelled image datasets teach a small neural network to tell cables, shoes and pet waste from open floor; the model is compressed to run on the onboard chip.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the dock
buildSteps.detail: The charging station is built with contacts, a dust-evacuation fan and sealed bags, plus pumps and tanks if it washes the mop.

buildSteps.title: Factory calibration and test
buildSteps.detail: Each robot is calibrated, driven through a test course, checked for suction and sensor faults, and its battery is cycled.

buildSteps.title: Update in the home
buildSteps.detail: Over-the-air software updates add rooms, fix navigation bugs and improve obstacle recognition as the fleet gathers more driving experience.

prerequisites.why: lets the robot build a map with a laser scanner while tracking its own position in it.
a vision model must run on battery power, in milliseconds, without a cloud connection.
they measure distances to walls and low obstacles accurately at consumer prices.
they give enough runtime to clean a whole home and recharge between rooms.
they let the robot receive maps, schedules and software improvements.

pathway.milestone: mapping robots that avoid cables and pet waste and empty their own bins
pathway.unlocks: hands-off daily cleaning in most homes.

pathway.milestone: finer semantic understanding of rooms and objects
pathway.unlocks: cleaning that changes suction and mopping by floor type, and reports what it saw.

pathway.milestone: robotic arms or grippers added to the platform
pathway.unlocks: picking up socks, toys and small debris before cleaning, not just driving around them.

pathway.milestone: a general home robot using the same navigation and AI stack
pathway.unlocks: tasks beyond floors, such as fetching items or monitoring the home.
